`slugify(input, { maxLength })` returns a string of at most `maxLength` characters
The cut lands on a separator, so no word is split
When the first word alone is longer than `maxLength`, that word is cut at `maxLength`
The result never ends in the separator
`maxLength` below 1, or not an integer, throws `RangeError`
Calls without `maxLength` return exactly what they return today
